Good Fighting Skill: Aya doesn't usually get into fights, so all the battles she has won have been "accidentally" while writing a report, so Aya is much stronger than she seems, all for the better report

Wind Manipulation: Thanks to her fans made of leaves, she is able to manipulate the wind, either changing its currents or stopping it completely. Somehow, this also allows Aya to "listen" to the wind to collect rumors, which is very useful in her job as a journalist.

Extraordinary Speed: Also, despite the fact that the tengu are known for their great speeds, Aya is considered an exception even among them and prides herself on being "the fastest" in Gensokyo.
